use_case.name: Purchase Order ERP Record Extraction
use_case.description: Extract structured header and line-item data from customer purchase order PDFs and produce an ERP-compatible JSON record for reviewer-verified entry.

business_spec.current_process: Order-processing employees inspect customer purchase orders received as PDFs and manually enter header and line-item information into the ERP system. A procurement or order-processing reviewer then verifies the generated record before it is transferred.
pain_points: Time-consuming manual data entry from diverse PO formats
Transcription errors (wrong quantities, prices, product codes, leading zeros)
Omission errors (missed fields, rows, or units)
business_spec.proposed_solution: AI-powered extraction of PO header and line-item fields from PDF documents into a structured ERP-compatible JSON record, followed by reviewer verification before transfer.
input_artifacts: Customer purchase order PDFs (digital and scanned)
success_criteria: Faster and more consistent ERP data preparation
Fewer manual transcription and omission errors
Reviewer-verifiable record produced before any ERP transfer
risks: Missing a row continued across pages
Altering product codes or leading zeros
business_spec.poc_goal: Given a supplied sample purchase-order PDF, extract the required header fields and all three line items into an ERP-compatible JSON record via a CLI interface. The PoC must accept the PDF, exit successfully, generate a non-empty parseable JSON record, preserve identifiers/leading zeros/article codes/dates/quantities/dimensions/units, and must not invent unsupported values for missing optional fields. Compare result semantically with fixtures/expected_erp_record.json. Out of scope: live ERP connection, PDF report, customer-specific format evaluation, numerical accuracy threshold.

technical_spec.domain_vocabulary: Four-digit item numbers (preserve leading zeros), case-sensitive article codes, vendor numbers, material grades, standards, dimensions with units, quantities with units, dates normalized to DD/MM/YYYY. product_form restricted to: Flat, round, rectangular bar. No separate domain glossary.
security_constraints: PO content must not be retained after processing
Original remains in source document system
Approved JSON and review decision may be retained (no exact retention period specified)
Authentication, RBAC, ERP credentials, and full audit-log implementation are out of PoC scope
External model APIs allowed; local-only processing not required

field_descriptions.purchase_order_number: Unique PO identifier as printed in the document; preserve leading zeros and punctuation.
field_descriptions.delivery_date: Requested delivery date, normalized to DD/MM/YYYY format.
field_descriptions.delivery_address: Full delivery address as stated in the PO header.
field_descriptions.vendor_number: Vendor/supplier identifier as printed; preserve leading zeros.
field_descriptions.line_items: List of line-item records, one per ordered item row.
field_descriptions.item_number: Four-digit line item number; preserve leading zeros.
field_descriptions.article_code: Case-sensitive article/product code exactly as written.
field_descriptions.dimensions: Dimensions string exactly as written (e.g. 12x1500x3000 mm).
field_descriptions.material_grade: Material grade designation exactly as written.
field_descriptions.quantity: Quantity including numeric value and unit exactly as written.
field_descriptions.product_form: Product form; must be exactly one of: Flat, round, rectangular bar.
field_descriptions.standard_designation: Material or product standard designation if present; null if absent.
field_descriptions.cut_length: Cut-to-length specification if stated; null if absent.
field_descriptions.temper_or_condition: Temper or delivery condition if stated; null if absent.
field_descriptions.hardness_hv: Hardness value in HV if stated; numeric only; null if absent.
field_descriptions.min_bend_radius: Minimum bend radius if stated; numeric only; null if absent.
field_descriptions.delivery_length_note: Any delivery length note or constraint if present; null if absent.
field_descriptions.applicable_standard: Applicable standard reference if present; null if absent.
field_descriptions.special_flags: Any special requirements or flags noted on the line item; null if absent.

validation_rules: delivery_date must be in DD/MM/YYYY format
product_form must be one of: Flat, round, rectangular bar
item_number must preserve leading zeros as four-digit string
article_code must preserve case and punctuation exactly
Optional fields must be null (not empty string) when not present in the document
Must not invent or hallucinate values for fields not present in the document

steps.name: Extract PO header and line items

parameters.task: Extract purchase order header fields (PO number, delivery date, delivery address, vendor number) and all line items from the document into an ERP-compatible structured record.
parameters.additional_instructions: Preserve all leading zeros in item numbers, article codes, and vendor numbers exactly as printed. Article codes are case-sensitive — do not normalize case or punctuation. Normalize all dates to DD/MM/YYYY format. product_form must be exactly one of: Flat, round, rectangular bar. For absent optional fields output null, never an empty string. Merge line-item rows split across page breaks into a single entry.

steps.name: Send extracted record and validation report to reviewer
Reviewer verifies and approves ERP record

traceability.required_by: input_type=pdf; scanned PDFs with complex multi-page tables, merged/hierarchical headers, and cross-page rows trigger accuracy override; chosen over DocumentsToStructuredData for highest extraction fidelity on visually complex documents
human_review=yes; pre-screens extraction quality (hallucinations, missing required fields) before the reviewer sees the record, reducing manual review effort
